name: Rescue the Survivors!: a Draenei Hero's Gift of the Naaru saves a survivor like a custom class's does (#6235)
contract: Report #6235: 'Rescue the Survivors!' (9283) does not complete for a Hero even after the survivor is healed to full.

The quest text says 'Use your Gift of the Naaru ability on one of the Draenei Survivors', and the Draenei Survivor (16483) credits the quest through npc_draenei_survivor when a Gift of the Naaru hits it.

SkillLineAbility teaches every Draenei Hero (class 10, ClassMask 512) spell 59542 under skill 760; its Spell.dbc row has no SpellFamilyFlags, unlike the stock variants the script matches by family flags.
A custom class learns 814280, 814281 or 814282, which the script names, and is credited.
Casting the Hero's own Gift on a survivor must credit the quest exactly as the custom class's Gift does.
